digest.component_or_area: Ruff lint configuration and datetime timezone handling
propositions: Enable Ruff ASYNC and DTZ rule families in the global Ruff configuration and prove the gated selection passes.
Give validate_checks.py explicit UTC timezone semantics for both integer epoch timestamps and offset-less persisted timestamp strings so they produce the same UTC cluster key.
Preserve security-pin cadence as a host-local calendar-date decision using an aware current instant converted to host timezone, compliant with DTZ005.
Prohibit the datetime.UTC token and require datetime.timezone.utc because the Ruff target-version remains py310, enforced by a recursive source scan.
Prove timezone invariance by running validation under at least two TZ settings via time.tzset, skipping on platforms lacking time.tzset.
The pyproject.toml edit has an ordering-only dependency on the Mypy strictness story to avoid sibling merge conflicts.
